theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start investing today, even with small amounts
body: Begin your investment journey with just ₹500 monthly. Consistency and time are your greatest assets as a young investor.
caption: Starting early means your money has more time to work. Small regular investments build wealth through disciplined habits. #YoungInvestor #SmallSteps #ConsistentInvesting #WealthBuilding #StartEarly
